description: The figure is a two-level donut pie chart representing the distribution of approximately 1.1K tasks across three main capability categories (inner ring) and nine subcategories (outer ring). The inner ring contains 3 slices labeled “Context Retrieving” (dark green/teal, roughly one-third), “Context Tracking” (dark blue, roughly one-third), and “Contradiction Resolution” (dark red/brown, roughly one-third), with the labels placed inside the slices. The outer ring contains 9 slices with callout labels and counts: “Triggering” (light blue, 100; ~9%), “Recursive Reasoning” (bright blue, 110; ~10%), “Dynamic Environment” (blue, 100; ~9%), “Memorization” (light cyan, 100; ~9%), “Dynamic Instruction” (teal, 100; ~9%), “Multitasking” (green, 160; ~14–15%), “Privacy Protection” (red, 111; ~10%), “Personalization” (salmon, 100; ~9%), and “Prioritization” (light pink, 100; ~9%). There is no separate legend and no percentage values printed on the slices; instead, the outer ring uses leader lines to the labels, and the donut has a small central hole with no slices visibly exploded or offset.
caption_used: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of 1.1K tasks across three primary categories and nine subcategories, with balanced sample sizes across capabilities. The central categories include 'Context Retrieving' (dark green), 'Context Tracking' (dark blue), and 'Contradiction Resolution' (dark red). Among the subcategories, 'Multitasking' has the highest value at 180, followed by 'Privacy Protection' at 121. Notably, 'Recursive Reasoning' demonstrates a consistent upward trend in its value compared to other subcategories. The chart provides a clear visual representation of the relative importance of each capability, with 'Dynamic Instruction' and 'Memorization' showing the lowest values at 90 each, indicating their lesser emphasis in the dataset.
